def clean(df):
    # Remove duplicate penguin_ids (keep first occurrence)
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['penguin_id'])
    
    # Fix species label variants (strip spaces, fix typo)
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace('Chinstarp', 'Chinstrap')
    
    # Convert numeric columns stored as text
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Remove rows with invalid flipper_length_mm (negative values)
    df = df[df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 0]
    
    # Remove rows with out-of-range body_mass_g (2500-6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    return df
